name: Chip foundries
one_line: Manufactures chips that other companies design. The factory floor of the AI boom.
sells: Finished silicon wafers, made to a customer's design
customers: Chip designers (NVIDIA, Apple, AMD, Broadcom, Qualcomm)
suppliers: Lithography machines, other fab equipment, silicon wafers, chemicals, power

revenue.note: One quarter times four; revenue was rising each quarter, so the trailing year is lower.

structure.why: TSMC alone takes roughly three of every four foundry dollars and leads at the most advanced manufacturing nodes.
structure.hhi_note: Mixed sources: TSMC, Samsung, SMIC from TrendForce Q2 2026; UMC and GlobalFoundries from Counterpoint Q1 2026 (pure-foundry basis).

econ: Economies of scale and the learning curve: each new factory is enormously expensive, and the firm that has made the most wafers makes them best, so the leader keeps pulling away.
